headline: First Lady Melania Trump has launched a 2027 White House AI competition for school students and a new seal that recognises schools for their readiness to use AI.
score_reason: National education programme from the White House; announced 13 Oct, no change from pool score.
importance_line: U.S. students, teachers and schools are invited to take part; it is a voluntary competition and recognition scheme, and its effect on classrooms is not yet known.
summary: MeriTalk reports that on 13 Oct 2026 First Lady Melania Trump opened the 2027 Presidential Super Intelligence Challenge, a contest for school students and teachers, with registration until 18 Dec 2026. The White House, which now calls AI "super intelligence" or "SI", also introduced a First Lady Seal of SI Readiness for schools that show progress on policies for responsible use, student privacy and teacher training, with evidence due by 30 Apr 2027.
